messages.subject: Layer_arcs drawing full circles despite providing angles
parts:
I've been trying to draw a single arc but the layer_arcs keeps drawing a full circle/donut despite providing start and end angles. Code example:

testData <- data.frame(initAngle=0,stopAngle=pi,
                       innerR=50,outerR=100)

testData %>%
  ggvis(innerRadius:=~innerR,outerRadius:=~outerR,
        startAngle=~initAngle,endAngle=~stopAngle) %>%
  layer_arcs()

Which produces this:
I've also tried supplying those values directly as parameters and it does the same thing. Any one know what I'm missing?
